title.narrative: UNIDO-CFDAIED Centers of Excellence in China

description.narrative: Food safety and drug supervision is a global issue. The significance of China in global food safety and drug supervision is rising and presenting to be unique and irreplaceable. The establishment of pool of professional food and drug inspectors is recognized as one of China#s strategic working priorities on food and drug safety. Food inspection is targeted in the #Healthy China 2030 Strategic Plan# and the 13th Five-Year National Plan on Food Safety, among which the latter requests to clarify and standardize the qualification, duty, training, management and evaluation for professional food inspectors, through strengthening training bases at the provincial level for inspectors and promoting online training platforms. Regulators are required to have at least 40 study hours per year for professional trainings, while entry level staff ought to have at least 90 hours every year. Food safety is also top-highlighted on the agenda of the cooperation between UNIDO and the former China Food and Drug Administration (CFDA). Both the #UNIDO-China Strategic Cooperation Framework 2018 # 2021# and the #UNIDO Country Programme for China 2016-2020# signed between the Ministry of Commerce of China and UNIDO recognize food safety as one of the emphases of the UNIDO-China cooperation.
